title: Multi-Instance Guidance Model
text: Reduced-order model for multiple UAVs, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Model Type} sets the uAV guidance model, {Number of Instances} sets the number of UAVs to simulate, {Data Type} sets the input and output numeric data, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Initial State} sets the initial UAV state tab multiple table, {Configuration} sets the uAV controller configuration tab multiple table and {Input/Output Bus Names} sets the simulink bus signal names tab. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Model Type
params.values: UAV guidance model type MultirotorGuidance (default) | FixedWingGuidance

params.name: Number of Instances
params.values: Number of UAVs to simulate 5 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Data Type
params.values: Input and output numeric data types double (default) | single

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Initial State
params.values: Initial UAV state tab multiple table entries

params.name: Configuration
params.values: UAV controller configuration tab multiple table entries

params.name: Input/Output Bus Names
params.values: Simulink bus signal names tab bus names
